subject: website
name: FileStamp
summary: A proof-of-creation tool that hashes a file locally and stamps the hash on Ethereum. It is served as written: readable app.js plus the vendored ethers library, so the page is its own public source (no licence file). It runs no third-party code. It is not Level 4: it reads chain data from public RPC endpoints (publicnode and others) when it opens and from the Etherscan API for history, without a light client.

connections.name: Ethereum RPC endpoints (publicnode, drpc, blastapi, nodies)
connections.note: Read when the page opens, without a light client.

connections.name: Etherscan API (api.etherscan.io)
